responsibility: Contains GCC selftests for core RTL utilities and printing behavior, enabled only in checking builds. The tests exercise compact RTL dumping of regs, insns, repeated nodes, and reuse markers; basic constructors and predicates such as single_set and jump classification; and constant/poly-int helpers like plus_constant and rtx-to-poly-int conversion, providing regression coverage for low-level RTL representation and pretty-printing routines rather than compiler passes.
